systems.owner: Government of Rwanda, supported by Vital Strategies under the Data for Health Initiative
systems.tiers: village leaders nationwide, by basic phone; rolled out nationwide in spring (year unstated, document published 2026-09-28); about 10,000 community deaths logged in its first months; the civil registrar receives a request to follow up

systems.system: link from death notification to the national ID database
systems.tiers: age, sex and location linked automatically from the national ID number sent by the village leader
local administrative cell staff, for deaths at home; 94% of registered deaths get one

note: Describes a death notification system, which the document itself distinguishes from registration; it says hospital deaths are registered but not how the registrar's record is made.
